mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the last 3 months, or the rank IC of the signal (FEDFUNDS 3mo decline) is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 316.0, it indicates high inflation, which signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 316.0, or the rank IC of the signal (CPI>316) is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4.0% and housing starts exceed 1350.0 (thousands), it indicates a tight labor market and strong housing demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 AND HOUST > 1350.0, or the rank IC of the signal (UNRATE<4.0 AND HOUST>1350) is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDP growth > 2.0% annualized), a decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points over the last 3 months signals a tightening labor market, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decline > 0.1pp AND GDP growth > 2.0% annualized, or the rank IC of the signal (UNRATE decline > 0.1pp) in late-cycle regimes is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the last 3 months signals strong supply conditions, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO has increased over the last 3 months, or the rank IC of the signal (INDPRO 3mo rise) is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1360.0 (thousands), it indicates strong housing demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1360.0, or the rank IC of the signal (HOUST>1360) is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 700000.0 (millions) and industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 102.0, it indicates strong demand and supply conditions, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 700000 AND INDPRO > 102.0, or the rank IC of the signal (RSAFS>700000 AND INDPRO>102) is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential sales (RSAFS) over the last 3 months signals strong demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS has increased over the last 3 months, or the rank IC of the signal (RSAFS 3mo rise) is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
